query: UPDATE deployment SET name = COALESCE($1, name), machine_type = COALESCE($2, machine_type), deploy_on_push = COALESCE($3, deploy_on_push), runner = COALESCE($4, runner), min_horizontal_scale = COALESCE($5, min_horizontal_scale), max_horizontal_scale = COALESCE($6, max_horizontal_scale), startup_probe_port = (CASE WHEN $7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE $7 END), startup_probe_path = (CASE WHEN $7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE $8 END), startup_probe_port_type = (CASE WHEN $7 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN $7 IS NULL THEN startup_probe_port_type ELSE 'http'::EXPOSED_PORT_TYPE END), liveness_probe_port = (CASE WHEN $9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE $9 END), liveness_probe_path = (CASE WHEN $9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE $10 END), liveness_probe_port_type = (CASE WHEN $9 = 0 THEN NULL WHEN $9 IS NULL THEN liveness_probe_port_type ELSE 'http'::EXPOSED_PORT_TYPE END), image_tag = COALESCE($12, image_tag) WHERE id = $11 RETURNING runner AS "runner: Uuid";
